scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/prepare-web.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:debug: cross-env CAP_DEBUG=true npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease assembleRelease
